name: SATURNE
summary: SATURNE is a Sarov programme using an intense tritium antineutrino source to study low-energy scattering and the neutrino magnetic moment. Its planned coherent scattering on entire atoms is distinct from coherent neutrino-nucleus scattering and from beta-endpoint mass spectroscopy.
detection_principle: Sub-keV atomic recoils in superfluid helium can produce quasiparticles and quantum evaporation, sensed by cryogenic detectors. Complementary silicon and scintillator concepts probe electromagnetic neutrino interactions.
